People's Majlis

People's Majlis Committee Minutes

7th Meeting of the Environment and Climate Change Committee

28 July 2026

Venue: People's Majlis [unclear] (Committee Room 6)

Start time: 11:00

{Presiding: Committee Chair; Member for South Maafannu constituency, Abdulla Rifau}

Remarks by the Chair:

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. I welcome all of you to the 7th meeting of the Environment and Climate Change Committee of the People's Majlis. This meeting is being held in Committee Room 6. Today's date is 28 July 2026, Tuesday. The time is 11:06. On today's agenda is the review of the Bill to amend Law No. 24/2022 (Waste Management Act), and, as a second item, other matters before this committee. Present at the committee at this time are: myself (Honourable Member for South Maafannu constituency, Abdulla Rifau), Member for Central Hulhumalé constituency Abdulla Shazeem, Member for West Maafannu constituency Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim, Member for Hithaadhoo constituency Mohamed Siruhaan, Member for Gemanafushi constituency Asadhulla Shihab, Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed, Member for Keyodhoo constituency Mohamed Niushad, and Member for North Hithadhoo constituency Abdulla Sodig. So, as of now, this law has come to us from the Committee of the Whole House, as a sub-committee, with the responsibility for us to review this law and, if we find that amendments need to be made to it, to finalise it in committee with those amendments and send it to the main committee. So, I open the floor to members' views to discuss how to proceed with this work. Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim.

Remarks by the Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim:

Thank you, Chair. Regarding the Bill to amend Law No. 24/2022 (Waste Management Act) that has been submitted, what I think is that, first, we should send it for comment to the relevant offices, that is, the Ministry of Environment, MIRA and the Economic Ministry, these three bodies, and request their comments. In writing. Not by bringing them here to work on it in person. Then, I also think it will be very important to finish this bill within this session, as it is the first bill submitted to the committee. And along with that, to seek public views, so that comments are received before 4 August, public comments

[stamp]

are received, to actually also announce it for public comment. Then, by that time, once we have received those letters from the relevant ministries or institutions and the public comments, we are looking to work on it and finish this bill by 10 July. So, the deadline is 10 July, 10 August, 10 August. Sorry. To work towards finishing the bill by 10 August as a deadline. That way we will be able to finish this bill within this session. And it is not a very big bill either. So, with that, I propose it in that way. I am proposing 3 things. One is that the deadline be 10 August. And to seek information in writing from the relevant parties. In that regard, to determine that the parties from whom information should be sought are the Ministry of Environment, MIRA and the Economic Ministry. And, along with that, to proceed with this work by making an announcement so that public views are received before 4 August, in order to seek public views. That way we expect the public will also get about five or six days. So, I propose these three proposals.

Remarks by the Chair:

Member for Vilifushi constituency, Hassan Waheed.

Remarks by the Member for Vilifushi constituency, Hassan Waheed:

Thank you, Chair. I would like to say that I second all 3 proposals made by the Honourable Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa.

Remarks by the Chair:

Thank you. A proposal has now been made on how to proceed with this bill. Therefore, yes! Although the proposal has been made on these three parts, I will take this to a vote as a single proposal. This proposal has now also been seconded. The proposal made by the Member for West Maafannu constituency, Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim, has been seconded by the Member for Vilifushi constituency, Hassan Waheed. Therefore, I open it to a vote to get the view on this proposal. (Voting) Thank you.

[stamp]

This proposal has been approved by the consensus of those present today. So, with the voting time also having arrived, we will close this committee here. I would also like to say that we will announce the date of the next committee meeting very soon. Thank you.
